summary: American Rebel Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a $270,000 promissory note with an accredited investor. The note carries an original issue discount of $40,500 and guaranteed interest of $40,500, netting $189,000 in proceeds, maturing April 2028. The note has a monitoring fee, minor default triggers at 105% acceleration, and general default at 130%. After 180 days, the lender may convert unpaid principal into Series D Convertible Preferred Stock at $7.50 per share, each convertible into five common shares, with a 4% ownership cap. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special-situation event.
